unit.unitinstructions:
Spanish 1000 Words

This tutor practices 1,000 high-frequency Spanish words using open Spanish-English dictionary and frequency data. Each card gives you an English gloss, and you type the matching Spanish word from memory.

  • What you will do: Read the English meaning and enter the Spanish word it describes.
  • Timing: Study and drill screens last about 20 seconds, review screens last about 5 seconds, and correct confirmations flash for about 0.5 seconds.
  • How it works: Immediate feedback connects the English gloss to the Spanish word, while adaptive scheduling brings uncertain words back sooner.
  • Study tip: Focus on the core meaning first, then use the gender marker when present to help learn masculine and feminine nouns.

Source and attribution: This flashcard deck is adapted from doozan/spanish_data, a Spanish-English dictionary and frequency-data repository built from Wiktionary, FrequencyWords, and Tatoeba sources. The deck uses Spanish-English dictionary data from es-en.data and Spanish lemma frequency data from frequency.csv.
